methodology: Four localized Catholic processional festivals were screened from municipal/tourist/foundation/bearer descriptions and a secondary scholarly historical review. Separate descriptions of actions, sequence steps, symbolic materials and 2026/2023 scheduled variants are indexed as component SOURCE DETAILS. More than one detail can share the same line or festival. These are not distinct customs or independent archival witnesses. No source pages from the underlying original medieval works have been directly checked. Entire witness/source lines cited by URL and web line; no book pages invented. No rite formula or prayers copied.
